question: What bright object gives us light during the day? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! The Sun is a giant star that shines brightly to give us warm daylight! ☀️
hint: It wakes us up in the morning.

question: What twinkles high up in the night sky? ✨
explanation: Great job! Stars are huge glowing balls of fire that look like tiny twinkling dots! ✨
hint: There are too many to count.

question: What seems to change its shape every single night? 🌙
explanation: Super! The Moon looks different as it moves, going from a full circle to a thin smile! 🌙
hint: It shines at night.

question: What looks like fluffy white cotton balls in the sky? ☁️
explanation: Fantastic! Clouds float in the sky and can look like fluffy white cotton or funny shapes! ☁️
hint: They move with the wind.

question: Which direction does the Sun rise from every morning? 🌅
explanation: Brilliant! The Sun always begins its day by rising in the East to wake us up! 🌅
hint: It starts with the letter E.

question: Which direction does the Sun set in the evening? 🌇
explanation: Excellent! When the day is done, the Sun always goes down in the West! 🌇
hint: It starts with the letter W.

question: What color is the clear sky on a sunny day? ☀️
explanation: Wonderful! On a sunny and clear day, our sky looks like a big blue blanket! 🟦
hint: It is the color of the ocean.

question: When is your shadow the shortest? 🕛
explanation: Perfect! At noon, the Sun is right above your head, making a very tiny shadow! 🕛
hint: It is during lunchtime.

question: When is your shadow very long? 🌅
explanation: Awesome! When the Sun is low in the morning, it stretches your shadow out long! 🌅
hint: When you just wake up.

question: What comes out in the sky after the rain? 🌈
explanation: Yay! A rainbow appears when sunlight shines through tiny leftover raindrops! 🌈
hint: It has seven beautiful colors.

question: How many colors make up a beautiful rainbow? 🌈
explanation: Great job! A rainbow has seven bright colors, starting with red and ending in violet! 🌈
hint: Count the colors in VIBGYOR.

question: What flash of bright light do we see during a storm? ⚡
explanation: Super! Lightning is a super bright flash of electricity that jumps from dark clouds! ⚡
hint: It looks like a zig-zag line.

question: What loud sound do we hear during a big storm? ⛈️
explanation: Fantastic! Thunder is the big, booming sound that comes right after a lightning flash! ⛈️
hint: It sounds like a giant drum.

question: What shape is a Full Moon? 🌕
explanation: Brilliant! A Full Moon looks like a big, bright, perfect circle shining in the night! 🌕
hint: It looks like a pizza pie.

question: What do we call the Moon when it looks like a slice of melon? 🌙
explanation: Excellent! A crescent moon looks just like a pretty smile or a slice of melon! 🌙
hint: It starts with the letter C.

question: Which of these is the closest star to our Earth? ☀️
explanation: Wonderful! The Sun is actually a star, and it is the closest one to our home, Earth! ☀️
hint: It warms us every day.

question: What color is the sky mostly at night? 🌌
explanation: Perfect! When the sun sets, the sky turns dark and black, letting the stars shine! 🌌
hint: It is the color of coal.

question: What toy can we fly high in the windy sky? 🪁
explanation: Awesome! A colorful kite loves to dance in the sky when the wind blows strong! 🪁
hint: It has a long tail.

question: What are rain clouds made of? 💧
explanation: Great job! Clouds are made of millions of tiny water drops floating together! 💧
hint: It gets us wet.

question: Where does the Moon get its bright light from? ☀️
explanation: Super! The Moon does not have its own light, it acts like a mirror reflecting the Sun! ☀️
hint: It comes from our daytime star.

question: Can we count all the stars in the night sky? 🔢
explanation: Fantastic! There are billions of stars out there, way too many for anyone to count! 🌌
hint: There are more than a million.

question: What beautiful animals fly happily in the sky? 🦅
explanation: Brilliant! Birds have wings that help them soar and play high up in the blue sky! 🦅
hint: They build nests in trees.

question: What big machine flies people through the clouds? ✈️
explanation: Excellent! Airplanes have big wings and jet engines to fly us across the sky! ✈️
hint: It lands at an airport.

question: What falls from dark grey clouds? 🌧️
explanation: Wonderful! Dark grey clouds are full of water, which falls down as cool rain! 🌧️
hint: You need an umbrella for it.

question: What special tool helps us see the stars closely? 🔭
explanation: Perfect! A telescope is a magic tube that makes faraway stars look very close and big! 🔭
hint: It looks like a long tube.

question: What fast vehicle takes astronauts to space? 🚀
explanation: Awesome! Rockets blast off with fire to take brave astronauts high into outer space! 🚀
hint: It zooms straight up.

question: What do plants need from the sky to grow? ☀️
explanation: Great job! Plants eat sunlight to stay healthy, grow tall, and make beautiful flowers! ☀️
hint: It makes the day warm.

question: What does the Sun give us besides light? 🌡️
explanation: Super! The Sun acts like a giant heater, keeping our whole planet nice and warm! 🌡️
hint: It makes you sweat in summer.

question: Why do stars look so tiny to us? ✨
explanation: Fantastic! Stars are actually huge, but they look tiny because they are very, very far away! 🌌
hint: Like looking down from a high building.

question: What color can the sky turn during a sunset? 🌅
explanation: Brilliant! When the sun goes down, it paints the sky with beautiful orange, pink, and red! 🌅
hint: It looks like a glowing fire.

question: What covers the stars so we can't see them during the day? ☀️
explanation: Excellent! The stars are always there, but the Sun is so bright it hides them until night! ☀️
hint: It is the light of the day.

question: What causes a dark shadow to form? 👤
explanation: Wonderful! A shadow is made when you stand in front of light and block it! 👤
hint: You stand in the way of the sun.

question: What is the Moon mostly made of? 🪨
explanation: Perfect! The Moon is a giant ball floating in space made of grey dust and hard rocks! 🪨
hint: You can find these on the ground.

question: What invisible force pushes the clouds across the sky? 🌬️
explanation: Awesome! The wind blows high up in the sky and pushes the clouds like fluffy boats! 🌬️
hint: You feel it on your face outside.

question: What big hot ball moves across the sky every day? ☀️
explanation: Great job! As our Earth spins, it looks like the big hot Sun is moving across our sky! ☀️
hint: It gives us morning and evening.

question: What do we use to see clearly outside at night? 🔦
explanation: Super! When the sky is dark at night, a torch gives us a beam of light to see our way! 🔦
hint: It needs batteries to work.

question: Which is much bigger in size? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! The Sun is incredibly huge, much, much bigger than our home, Earth! ☀️
hint: It is the king of the solar system.

question: What do we call the time when the sky is light? 🌞
explanation: Brilliant! When the Sun is up and shining, we call it day time, perfect for playing! 🌞
hint: You go to school during this.

question: What do we call the time when we sleep and the sky is dark? 🛏️
explanation: Excellent! When the Sun sets and stars come out, it is night time, time to rest! 🌌
hint: You wear pajamas for this.

question: Who are the smart scientists that study the stars? 🔭
explanation: Wonderful! Astronomers use giant telescopes to look at the sky and learn about space! 🔭
hint: Their name starts with an A.

question: What color does the bright Sun look to us? 💛
explanation: Perfect! To our eyes, the glowing hot Sun looks like a big, beautiful yellow ball! 💛
hint: It is the color of a banana.

question: Are stars in the sky during the day time too? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! Stars never leave! The Sun is just too bright during the day for us to see them! ✔️
hint: They do not run away.

question: What do dark and heavy clouds usually bring? ⛈️
explanation: Great job! When clouds get super thick, dark, and heavy, they drop rain down on us! 🌧️
hint: You need a raincoat.

question: What happens to our shadow as the evening comes? 🌇
explanation: Super! As the Sun goes low in the evening sky, it stretches our shadows out very long! 📏
hint: Like the morning, it stretches.

question: What do we call a night when we cannot see the Moon at all? 🌑
explanation: Fantastic! A New Moon is when the Moon's dark side faces us, so it hides in the night sky! 🌑
hint: It starts with the word New.

question: What rises in the sky to tell us morning is here? 🌅
explanation: Brilliant! The golden Sun rises in the East every single morning to start a brand new day! ☀️
hint: Roosters crow when it comes up.

question: What do we call the big dark space where stars and planets live? 🌌
explanation: Excellent! Outer space is the huge, magical, dark place where our Earth and the stars live! 🌌
hint: Astronauts go there.

question: Which of these stays in the sky all day and all night? ☁️
explanation: Wonderful! Clouds can float around during the sunny day and also hide the Moon at night! ☁️
hint: They bring rain.

question: What makes the Moon look so pretty and bright? 🌟
explanation: Perfect! The Sun is so bright that its light bounces right off the Moon, making it glow! ☀️
hint: It is light from the daytime.

question: What wondrous thing makes our Earth a bright and warm place to live? 🌍
explanation: Awesome! The Sun is our special star that gives Earth all the warmth and light we need to live happily! ☀️
hint: It shines every day.
